## 1. Goal

Each of the two tutorial decks gets its known errors corrected and a recorded
video, linked from the [Talks page](../../talks.qmd#fundamental-concepts-of-pkpd)
beside its PDF and Google Slides links.

Out of scope: new material. The decks keep their content and order; only the
errors change.

## 2. The Decks

| Deck | Slides | PDF | Working copy |
|---|---|---|---|
| Introduction to Fundamental PK Concepts | 45 | [`files/2019-08-01-fundamental-pk.pdf`](../../files/2019-08-01-fundamental-pk.pdf) | [Google Slides](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1_0wrRgCmRGN3TEFx87I0en6TiSckjbOp/edit) |
| Introduction to Fundamental PD Concepts | 117 | [`files/2019-08-01-fundamental-pd.pdf`](../../files/2019-08-01-fundamental-pd.pdf) | [Google Slides](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1IjaNyPhachTDWn2TO9YuVegsCTOSpiCp/edit) |

## 3. Errors to Correct

The errors a colleague found, one row each. A row is done when the working
copy is fixed.

| # | Deck | Slide | Error | Correction | Fixed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | | | *To be filled in from the colleague's list.* | | |

## 4. Steps

1. Fill in Section 3 from the colleague's list.
2. Correct each error in the working copy and mark its row.
3. Export each corrected deck to PDF and replace the file under `files/`,
   keeping the filename so existing links still work.
4. Record a video for each deck.
5. Add a video link beside each deck on the Talks page.
